title: United Baptist Chuch was built 1898, 1905 united Primitive and Free Baptists
description: On May 3, 1895, the Baptist Church was organized. Later, at a joint meeting on July 1, 1906, the Free Baptist Church and the Baptist Church united to form a single congregation, with Rev. A. T. Baker serving as their first pastor. The church building, constructed in 1898 for $2200, originally served the Baptist Church before the union. This photograph was taken after 1901.
